description: This header file defines interfaces for a message bus component, including initialization, finalization, engagement, resource freeing, and status checking functions related to SSP message bus operations.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Initiates engagement with the message bus using component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with optional user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the message bus interface with optional user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus with optional user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus, with given priority and user data.
